name: Beacon
description: A dark, precise launch page: one promise, the product's own interface drawn in the page and rising out of a violet glow, a launch track lit up to now, pricing, updates and a waitlist at both ends.

questions.question: What do visitors sign up for?

options.label: A waitlist
options.description: An email to hear at launch, at the top and at the end of the page.

options.label: Pre-orders
options.description: The plans become founding offers to reserve; the form takes a reservation.

options.label: Already launched
options.description: The forms become a sign-up button to the product; the track ends at launch.

options.label: Yes, the plans
options.description: The plans section stays, with the maker's prices.

options.label: Not yet
options.description: The plans go; the questions say pricing comes at launch.
